title: Dewlight Skip
description: Original cheerful, chipper grove theme: 16 bars in C major, 4/4 at 125 BPM. A high, detached sine melody overlaps an independent, rhythmically displaced triangle countermelody; tiny descending triangle toms mark every quarter-note beat. No block chords or sustained bass bed. A G turnaround returns to C every 30.72 seconds.
